scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/game-core && npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/protocol && npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/presentation-model && npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/session-client
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/game-server && npm run build --workspace @exploding-kitty/minigame && npm run build --workspace prototype
scripts.test: npm --workspace @exploding-kitty/minigame run test:build-environment && npm --workspace @exploding-kitty/minigame run test:runtime-config-bundle && vitest run && npm --workspace prototype test
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces
